title: Revoked verifier key
preconditions: independent publisher-authorized revocation state marks the verifier key revoked
the attacker controls the revoked online signing key but not the independent trust authority
steps: Use a revoked verifier key to sign a permit and certify its own unrevoked status or replacement root.
invariants: M1-015 V07: Verifier-key revocation is independently enforced by the relying party; the revoked key cannot certify its own recovery
residual_risk: Compromise of the independent revocation/root authority remains a separate TCB risk.
Specified attack requirement only; runtime implementation and proof remain deferred.
